findings.body: In pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/impl.go, the TagDevice method calls tagDeviceUI which calls anonStore.CreateOrUpdateDevice. If CreateOrUpdateDevice returns an error, TagDevice logs it and returns the error. However, in pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/client.go, the Anonymous.Authenticate method calls anonDeviceService.TagDevice and returns the error if it is ErrDeviceLimitReached, but for other errors it only logs a warning and returns nil error. This means that errors other than ErrDeviceLimitReached are swallowed silently in Authenticate, which could hide real failures in tagging devices.
findings.suggestion: In Anonymous.Authenticate, return all errors from TagDevice instead of swallowing non-ErrDeviceLimitReached errors. For example, remove the else branch that swallows errors and always return the error.
findings.title: Anonymous.Authenticate swallows errors from TagDevice except ErrDeviceLimitReached

models.summary: The change adds support for limiting anonymous devices and propagates the device limit error properly. However, the Anonymous.Authenticate method swallows errors from TagDevice except for ErrDeviceLimitReached, which can hide failures in tagging devices. This error handling inconsistency should be fixed to improve robustness.
